title: Caller-owned rows in public array operations
summary: Bounded nullable arrays preserve independent row widths, primitive values and shared identities across Commons Lang, Collections and Math.

subject.system: Caller-owned rows in public array operations

change.description: Bounded nullable arrays preserve independent row widths, primitive values and shared identities across Commons Lang, Collections and Math.

notes: The opening comparison uses the released JARs and Temurin 21.0.13. The standalone, ordinary native, integrated JBMC and physical JVM evidence is measured per statement.

Both dimensions and every cell are independent at the direct entry. An alias names an earlier row, while equal separate rows have their own cell lists. The 209-graph JVM census contains 12 shared nonempty cases. The direct Commons Math transfer retains actual and expected mismatch dimensions.
